items.title: Regeneron (REGN) Stock Trades Below Fair Value As POTS Trial Progresses
items.summary: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals has seen its share price climb over multiple time frames, and with the stock recently closing at US$957.76, the real question for you is whether that level is supported by the earnings the business is generating today. Over the past 5 years the stock has delivered a 48.9% return, which puts real weight on the issue of whether the current valuation is still in step with its earnings power.
